authority_note: Project, Goal, Task, Evidence and Decision Memory remain the runtime authorities. This ledger only indexes bounded enhancement proof.

enhancements.PROBLEM: Engineering artifacts are commonly evaluated from the author's viewpoint even when observed actors, usage conditions and risks require other perspectives.
enhancements.TARGET_CAPABILITY: Model-native bounded perspective applicability under the existing Task Contract
enhancements.WHY: Activate relevant engineering judgment without a fixed role checklist, extra model call, default Skill load or parallel state authority.

STATUS_HISTORY.basis: Read-only UI observation proved dynamic perspective selection but did not yet prove external fact-reference grounding.
The ledger was downgraded while external grounding, critical-risk omission and real-field rerun evidence were pending.
External fact grounding, known-critical-risk omission protection, acceptance semantics, real UI rerun and affected gates passed.

enhancements.CURRENT_AUTHORITY: Existing Task Contract; ChatGPT selects semantics, an external task-bounded observed-fact catalog supplies evidence receipts, and the runtime validates invariants
enhancements.REAL_PROJECT_OUTCOME: The same read-only UI field was rerun without authored source changes. All artifact, actor, usage, risk and project refs resolved in an external bounded catalog; acceptance labels were explicitly non-authoritative semantics; 23 focused tests and affected plugin gates passed.

enhancements.PROBLEM: Existing architecture, impact, implementation and decision capabilities do not provide one evidence-grounded model-native contract for choosing whether to modify, abstract, consolidate, delete or keep the current structure.
enhancements.TARGET_CAPABILITY: Model-native Structural Change Decision Intelligence under the existing Task Contract
enhancements.WHY: Preserve model freedom while deterministically rejecting fabricated, stale, unsafe, contradictory or unbounded structural decisions.

STATUS_HISTORY.basis: The bounded capability audit identified reusable fact sources, one legacy overlapping input and the missing unified five-action decision contract; no production implementation existed at this phase.
One optional model-selected Task Contract section, one shared observed-fact catalog and deterministic action prerequisites were defined without a new manager, workflow, state plane or model call.
The bounded validator, schema, tamper-evident receipt, Task Contract persistence and Architecture Guard consumer were implemented with legacy/new authority conflict rejection.
A-K counterexamples, patch-on-patch reconsideration, receipt tamper detection, schema and evidence-field tests passed; all new source and test files remain below 200 lines.
Affected Core, Workspace and Quality suites passed; Perspective and Structural Decision share one evidence catalog; default route output remained byte-identical.
Two read-only real business repositories produced validated MODIFY_EXISTING and CONSOLIDATE_SIMPLIFY decisions while their HEAD, status and bound-source fingerprints remained unchanged.

enhancements.CURRENT_AUTHORITY: The existing Task Contract remains the sole task writer; ChatGPT selects one structural action and the runtime only validates external evidence, action prerequisites and receipt integrity.
enhancements.REAL_PROJECT_OUTCOME: Two read-only real projects passed: one MODIFY_EXISTING decision prevented an unproved abstraction, and one CONSOLIDATE_SIMPLIFY decision identified byte-identical active readiness authorities with explicit migration and rollback boundaries. Implementation field was NOT_RUN_JUSTIFIED.
